caption_L1: This line diagram is named Number of enterprises in the manufacture of soft drinks , production of mineral waters and other bottled waters industry in Denmark from 2008 to 2017. The y-axis plots Number of enterprises while the x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: There is no overall trend in this graph. It shows two peaks (in 2010 and 2017), with the latest being the highest at 22 enterprises. The two lowest points belong to 2008 and 2014, with the least number of enterprises being 12. Overall, it seems like the amount of enterprises sharply increases, and is then followed by a slow reduction in their numbers, which then leads to a new explosion.
